matcher-transaction.actual_behavior: Default Match preflights the WHOLE pattern with capture=false, then runs it with capture enabled only after success. A failed whole Match does not alter capture pointers. A successful Match followed by a false C++ conjunct DOES retain captures.

matcher-any-order.actual_behavior: Normal non-explaining AnyOrder tries pattern1->operand0/pattern2->operand1 first, then swapped. It preflights each orientation without capture. Later caller predicates do not backtrack into this choice.

matcher-one-use.actual_behavior: WithOneUse requires exactly one user AND exactly one occurrence in that user operands. user_count()==1 alone permits repeated occurrences.

IsAll.actual_behavior: UnwrapToConstant follows operand0 through Broadcast, Copy, DynamicSlice, Reshape, Reverse, Slice, Transpose; then literal.IsAll(value). Literal overload CHECKs scalar. This is the source storage/view test, not universal mathematical evaluation.

IsAllFpConstantPowerOf2.actual_behavior: Match effective-scalar Constant direct or Broadcast(Constant with effective-scalar shape); GetConstantValue then frexp mantissa == +/-0.5. No nonoverflow, finite-output, or underflow conjunct is added.

IsNonNegative.actual_behavior: Keep pinned source switch/recursion, including Exp=true, unsigned/nonsigned Abs=true, same-input nonsigned Multiply=true; constants reject negative-sign/NaN; Maximum uses OR; default delegates to pinned IsPositive. This predicate is not a theorem of nonnegativity or non-NaN.

TryDivideToShift.actual_behavior: Integral caller dispatch only. Direct effective-scalar Constant preferred over Broadcast effective-scalar Constant; signed int64 b_value>0 && singlebit, else unsigned uint64 singlebit. Returns constructed unique_ptr or null. Signed path adds intermediates before returning final Select.

InvertConstant.actual_behavior: Literal::Populate<T> computes native T{1.0}/constant.literal().Get<T>(indices); status propagates. No fast-math guard or symbolic reciprocal simplification.

MinMaxToClamp.actual_behavior: CHECK both Broadcast(ConstantEffectiveScalar) captures; reshape literals to scalar; build temporary scalar constants, PRED compare lower<upper with default comparison attributes and layout update; evaluate. Error propagates, all-true yields uninserted Clamp with to_clamp shape and original bound broadcasts; false yields null and caller continues. Temporary evaluation nodes are not inserted into the main computation.

IsNondecreasingSublinear.actual_behavior: Opcode whitelist Cbrt/Erf/Logistic/Tanh only; not a numerical monotonicity/sublinearity proof.

compatible-existing.actual_behavior: Reject nonempty old control predecessors or !SameShape. Otherwise visitor existing replacement preserve_sharding=true, preserve_frontend_attributes=true, then StatusOr.value(): false may continue, non-OK value access is fatal rather than propagated handler Status.

visitor-new.actual_behavior: Default preserve_sharding=false, relay_controls=false, remove_unused=true, preserve_frontend_attributes=true. Calls computation-new; any OK marks changed=true, including low-level unchanged/skip OK.

visitor-existing.actual_behavior: Existing replacement relays controls=true, remove_unused=true; explicit preserve flags. StatusOr overload ORs changed with returned bool. Status overload uses preserve_sharding=false, DCHECKs successful bool, returns status.

computation-new.actual_behavior: AddInstruction(new) occurs BEFORE low-level replacement. Relay=false may return unchanged because old has controls; DCHECK(changed), returns OK in builds without assertion failure. Allocation survives rejection; visitor marks changed on OK.

computation-existing.actual_behavior: Requires compatible shapes, sharding skip only if preserve_sharding=true, relay/copy/drop control path or no-relay controlled-old skip. Copies metadata/original values/sharding/frontend attrs under source guards, rewires users/root, removes old and unused operands. Status failures do not provide transactional rollback.

operand-rewire.actual_behavior: Requires CompatibleIgnoringFpPrecision; checks bounds; same pointer returns OK; otherwise updates operand/user lists. Does not relay controls/delete old producer or mark visitor changed by itself.
